notes.title: Enchantress Alt Class and fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have some exciting news for you! There are now 3 alt classes total, with the newest added today, the Enchantress. She works by enchanting monsters to join your party, but to her they are expendable...

-----------------------------------
Enchantress: 
Has 3 abilities, and a passive effect for a 70% chance to recruit a monster after combat. Additionally, she comes with the Druid's default passive effects. 

Each ally of the enchantress gets a debuff to take 5% max HP as damage each turn. When an ally dies, it damages all enemies for 20% of the ally's max HP.

Enchantress skills:

Skill 1: damage a random enemy 35% of the total missing HP of all allies
Skill 2: Heal all allies 50 HP (need test)
Skill 3: Revive the last ally who died 
-----------------------------------

Big additions:
-You can now recruit over your limit after combat, but the game will prompt you to kick an ally from your group to make room.

Other fixes:
-improved french translation
-cheap armor starting artifact now makes it so you take 0 damage the first round of combat (was 50% before)
-ally HP bonus at skill tree from +30 to +20

notes.title: v1.08 Monk, Balancing, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for continuing to play the game. I hope you will enjoy this new update with the new Monk Alt Class for the Mage!

This alt class is unique because it comes with 3 unique activatable abilities!

Here are the patch notes:

v1.08
-Added new Mage Alt Class - the Monk!

Monk: 
Has Passive: Holy Monk: When a card buffs, heals, or restores your mana, gain 1 Chi and add 1 charge to your abilities.
Starts with 3 Abilities that are unlocked at levels 2,3, and 4. 

Changes: 
-Poison Cloud / Frost Bite now can have their secondary effects resisted
-Monk special abilities are balanced between Energy Mode/Classic Mode
-Deflect card now blocks 7 damage instead of 10
-Spelling fixed for Berserker

Bug Fix:
-Fixed the last boss spawning his images on top of his position

Enjoy!!

notes.notes:

A small update today introducing alternate classes (starting with the Warrior), and hopefully will be releasing 1 for each character in the coming weeks!

Hi everyone! This patch has something to like for people playing the demo and the extended demo! I hope you do enjoy it. Feel free to leave feedback in the discord channel: https://discord.gg/BjVTtPGZfD

[u]Patch Notes:[/u]

[b]Balance:[/b]
-Player levels up more slowly
-Player now only gets new cards in every other fight, instead of every fight (to stop clogging deck)
-Allies only get +3stats/ level instead of +4
-Changed “Scroll of Preparation” artifact, now gives a decayed blade into your grid
-Made it so multiple “Crab Claw” artifacts stack
-Slightly reduced higher weapon damage limit

[b]Game:[/b]
-Completed function of all nodes in skill tree (for full release)
-Completed function of 8/10 ascension levels (for full release)

-Added in new artwork for remaining World Map 2 enemies
-Added in new artwork for all shops in the game including shopkeepers

-Added in new map variation for World Map 1 (there are now 3 different layouts)
-Changed the way trees are placed in the map (now they will cascade up/down and you can pass through trees where you are blocked.
-Fixed the bug of having a tree blocking your path

-Curses now deal 1hp damage/turn for each curse in your deck

[b]Cards:[/b]
-Added new card “Decayed Blade”
-Changed “Lightning” to also deal 25% splash damage to other enemies

[b]Bugs:[/b]
-fixed bug where artifact tier weapons would have missing stats and cause an exception error
-fixed bug where “Demon Gloves” would play every card twice (should only be attack cards)
-fixed translation bug on Language Menu

If you would like to try the extended demo, type “ccc” on the title screen. Enjoy!

There are also some minor gameplay changes, such as being able to save your deck edits, and how the combo grid repeats cards now. More updates coming soon :) 

Enjoy!

End of Run UI
Starting artifacts ui
Bottom bar ui upgrade

Art

notes.title: Demo v0.5 BIG UI and Talent Tree Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Thanks for reading my update. The main focus of this update was to create a talent tree for meta progression, and to work on the UI. The talent tree features 45 unique talents to learn. The Combat UI has been completely redone including the combo grid and all the rewards. New enemies were added, including a new 2nd World Boss!  

-If you want to get the extended demo, please join the Discord and ask for the code. That will allow you to fight the 2nd boss, and see the beginning of world 3!

Download the Demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054770/Combo_Card_Clashers/

[h1]Patch Notes (Demo v0.5)[/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Meta Progression Talent Tree[/h3]
[list]
[*] added 3 separate skill trees (Combat, Magic, and Leadership)
[*] Each tree has 15 different talents
[*] 1 talent from each tree is unlockable in the demo
[*] You earn talent points by completing the demo (if you earn enough EXP)
[/list]

[h3]World[/h3]
[list]
[*] World Map #3 added
[*] Warrior story for world 3 added
[*] Mage story for world 3 added
[/list]

[h3]New Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] “New World 2 Boss”: (only available in extended demo) 
[*] “Champion Soldier”: An enemy who deals more dmg the more health he is missing, has single target attack, and cleave attack
[*] “Demon Monk”: Has a passive barrier, a poison spray attack, and an attack up buff
[/list]

[h3]New UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Combat scene UI completely redone
[*] 	New art for: combo grid, buttons, rewards windows, health and mana bars etc.
[*] Debuffs under them are now under the health and mana bar instead of below the enemy
[/list]

[h3]Shops Rework:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spell Shop offers 4 cards instead of 3
[*] Now sells 4 random artifacts
[*] Layout has been changed
[*] Minimum card cost is now 100
[*] Weapon Shop now sells 4 random artifacts
[*] Layout has been changed
[/list]

[h3]Barrier Mechanic:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added in a barrier mechanic that blocks a set amount of damage. If not 0, it continues into the next round.
[*] Some barriers refresh each round
[/list]

[h3]Barrier Card[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a barrier card for players (gives a barrier that blocks up to 10 damage and lasts 3 rounds)
[/list]

[h3]Number indicator [/h3]
[list]
[*] for debuffs that have a set duration (ex: sleeping enemies, or… certain bosses)
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]

[h3]Cards:[/h3]
[list]
[*] rebalanced starting mage spells 
[*] -”Fireball” reduced mana cost by 5
[*] -”Lightning” reduced mana cost by 5
[*] Cards that block damage have been buffed to block more damage
[*] “Immolation” now gives dmg resist
[*] “Dark prism” also adds damage for each debuff on the enemy
[*] “Hone skill” mana cost dcr by 10
[/list]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] “Summoner Sword” Enemy hp increased by 75 and damage incr by 5
[*] “Imp” now has 50 less hp, and reduced status resistance
[*] “Golem” is now weaker, and comes with 2 instead of one.
[*] “Pipe of friendship” bonus decreased from 25% to 15%
[*] “Poisonous Shroom” now gives +2 poison at start instead of +1
[*] Some enemy attacks have been modified for when theyre recruited on your team. Ex: Satyr and Bear (so their damage doesn't scale out of control)
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upper weapon range damage decreased by 2
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Couldnt move gear if you tried to sell it previously 

[h3]Demo Restrictions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demo now has restricted progress. Cannot go past 75% of world 2 unless you have the Extended Demo Code found in the discord channel
[*] Cards unlocked, deckbuilding cards, and artifacts limit is restricted unless you have the Extended Demo Code found in the discord channel
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.4 Major Game Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Sorry its been so long with holidays etc. Here is the next update though :) Tons of changes I am sure you will enjoy. The demo is longer now, and there are more new monsters to defeat! The map gives more opportunities too, and there is a lot of beautiful new artwork to see and game choices to make! Enjoy and see you next update! 

Patch Notes

Big Changes
-Hex tiles have been rotated so player has 3 movement choices instead of 2 when on world map
-Events page redesigned to look like Story Page
-New artwork for all Events
-World map compass removed, and now all sites have tooltips
-Cards now have sub tooltips to explain any additional information (such as buffs/debuffs/discard after play/ etc)
-Enemy damage is less by ⅓ the first 3 rounds of combat
-Combat UI revised (smaller for more space)
-Position of Hero, Allies, Enemies adjusted
-Length before end of demo has been extended to right before end of world map 2

-4 new encounters have been created in the 2nd world map 
[list]
[*] Treant and Werewolves
[*] Zombie Bear 
[*] 3 Spirits
[*] Demon Imps
[/list]
-4 new events created
[list]
[*] Fallen Gladiator
[*] Gobline Carnival 
[*] Demonic Encounter
[*] Possessed Skull
[/list]
-8 new cards
[list]
[*] Single target stun
[*] Multi target stun
[*] Repeat Column
[*] Repeated Strike
[*] Block Fixed Damage
[*] Exploding Corpse
[*] Ice Blast
[*] Upgrade Next Card
[/list]
-4 new artifacts created
[list]
[*] 3% dmg reduction
[*] 40% chance to not discard a (discard after play) card
[*] +10 gold for each space traveled in map
[*] all enemies start with 1 poisoned (except sleeping units)
[/list]
-New Art:
[list]
[*] Mage Hero 
[*] Recruited Companions
[*] Summons (Skeleton and Skeleton Mage)
[*] Enemies World 1 (Snake and Witchdoctor, Golem, Satyr, Slime King, Illusion Boss)
[/list]

Small Changes
-Card Viewer now shows 4 cards per row instead of 3
-Weapon modifiers (ex: 3% chance to cast a spell, lifesteal etc.) now work for Allies/Recruited Enemies
-End of run rewards now loops back to the start if you reach the end of the rewards (more rewards are possible this way)	 
-VFX size and position corrected when using most player cards
-Shows “No Mana” if an enemy doesnt have mana for a spell
-Discard after play cards now only have 3 uses and a number indicator
-Dire Rats encounter now has 1 less rat
-For the player Physical/Magical resistance is now just Damage Resistance, though enemies still have physical/magical resistance
-some UI SFX changes

Bug Fixes
-Fixed summons not being summoned correctly if someone in your party had died during combat
-Fixed trashed cards not being able to be used in the next combat
-Fixed locked cards carrying over locked status into next combat (from the Satyr’s lock card spell)
-Fixed Mage Hero death turning into the warrior during animation
-FixedSplitting Slime problem when it splits and on your team (no longer splits if its on your team)
-Fixed bound cultist doesn't heal lowest hp ally all the time when on your team. 
-Fixed bound cultist hard to see their status effects
-Fixed UI issues like bottom bar overlapping victory window, and end of run rewards window
-Fixed chain lightning sfx going off when sound is off
-Fixed being able to click further ahead while traveling on the map, and activating a location your player wasnt on
-Fixed bug with HP/Mana bars not being in the correct position when illusion boss duplicated
-Fixed player alignment with HP/Mana bars
